topic: What happens if you step into quicksand?
title: Stuck In Quicksand
hook: What if you stepped into quicksand?

beats.line: Good news: quicksand is denser than you, so you can't sink all the way.
Most people only sink to about their waist.
But yanking one foot out fast takes force like lifting a car.
So don't pull. Wiggle your legs slowly to let water in.
Then lean back, float, and slide yourself free.

end.line: Did the movies lie to you about quicksand?

description: You won't sink like in the movies, but you won't pull free either: the physics of quicksand.

facts.claim: Quicksand is about twice as dense as water and denser than the human body, so people cannot fully sink.
A person typically sinks only to about the waist.
Pulling a foot out quickly can require a force similar to lifting a car.
facts.source: Bonn et al. (2005), Nature; University of Amsterdam press release

facts.claim: Slow wiggling lets water in and loosens the sand.
